about: The local board already has accepted AD-2, so this case checks whether the plan moves the existing selection status below the board using its concrete anchors while leaving visual quality to manual review.

request.prompt: This repository contains a local 8×8 board with square selection, an existing polite selection status, and Reset. Move the existing status immediately below the board so it serves as the selected-square summary: it shows the selected coordinate and returns to “Choose a square” when Reset is used. R-1: Use the accepted board direction recorded in the product documentation to shape the moved status and plan a rendered browser check at narrow and wide widths in light and dark themes. R-2: Preserve all 64 selectable local squares, the existing selection announcement and reset behavior, and the existing node:test suite. Stay local, with no dependencies or external service.
